items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1960-09-16
items.q: I played actually with the Eureka band, you know? Yes. And Sonny's plays. Sometime Albert plays.

ctx.x: He died not so long ago. A couple months ago. A couple months ago. A couple months ago. Harrison Bone.
I played actually with the Eureka band, you know? Yes. And Sonny's plays. Sometime Albert plays.

I wonder if you could tell us a little bit more. I'm interested in Vic Gaspar especially since I never got to talk to him or even meet him. Did you hear him with any dance bands much in those days? Oh yeah, there was lots of dance bands. Was he still playing then when you came to town? Oh sure. He's playing. He played at the Lyric Theater. I was in town since 1910. Oh I didn't know. I thought maybe you didn't get here until 1925 or something. No, no, no. Oh you came down early then. Oh I didn't know. Vic Gaspar…
